(DWA, also known as DreamWorks Animation Studios or simply DreamWorks) is an American animation studio, owned by Comcast's NBCUniversal as part of Universal Filmed Entertainment Group. The studio has produced 54 feature films, its first film, Antz, was released on October 2, 1998, and its latest film, Forgotten Island, was released on September 25, 2026.
In addition, two unannounced films are scheduled to be released on September 24, 2027 and September 22, 2028, respectively.

Formed as a division of DreamWorks Pictures on October 12, 1994, with alumni from Amblin Entertainment's former animation branch Amblimation, it was spun off into a separate company on October 27, 2004. The studio initially made some traditionally animated films, as well as three stop-motion co-productions with Aardman Animations, but since 2006, it now exclusively relies on computer animation.
